title: Karla Turner's husband abducted by the military
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Karla Turner's husband abducted by the military, about late 20th century at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Turner's husband was abducted by elements of the military

plain: A filmmaker named Tim Alberino, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about Karla Turner, an American author who wrote about alien abductions. Alberino says that Turner's husband was abducted, not by aliens, but by elements of the military. If true, it would suggest that some abduction experiences involve human military groups.
